verdict.rationale: Aider is a local, open-source CLI coding agent with no hosted service, account system, or HTTP API of its own. It consumes LLM-provider API keys rather than issuing credentials, so a story about issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a category error for this product's role. Nothing in the evidence shows Aider shipping any credential-issuance capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
